divergences.expected: Border drag dispatches moveGutterOp with the literal coalesce key 'gutter'.
divergences.found: src/ui/SpreadView.tsx onBorderDown sets key `gutter:${e.timeStamp}`, so each drag gets its own coalesce key. The store (src/state/store.ts:42-46) merges every consecutive dispatch that shares one key, so the literal 'gutter' would merge two separate drags in a row into one undo step. A per-drag key keeps one drag = one undo step.
